verdict.rationale: The marketing site claims users can see spend and return by channel and 'receive alerts and strategic insights by AI' [conta-simples-docs-21], a first-party claim of in-product AI-generated insights from the user's own spend data. That is the only evidence, a single marketing line with no product documentation of how the insights or suggestions work. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the AI insights feature (what data it analyzes, what kinds of suggestions it gives, where it appears in the product), evidence of actionable AI suggestions beyond alerts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
